acceptanceCriteria: tests validity on an RSpec spec lists every example in line order with hygiene and a strength member, pinned by a CLI test.
Uncertain files keep the existing behaviour with a named abstention.
body: Found in V1-1858 (PR #1161, head 2817789aa, corvint build 664). Expected: tests validity lists each RSpec example with hygiene and strength, symmetric with the JS/TS per-example output (TSA-V0-073/081). Actual: RSpec lists only tests a finding names.
title: tests validity: list every RSpec example as JS/TS now does, not only examples a finding names
